subject: Re: VPC deployment — commercial concessions & ops tranching
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@vermillionhealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@vermillionhealth.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VPC deployment — commercial concessions & ops tranching

Sergio / Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team is excited about Redwood but we need to close commercials before execs sign off. A few asks from procurement and engineering:

- Platform fee: can you provide a stepped platform fee that starts lower in year 1 while we finish PoC, then ramps up in Y2?
- Support tiers: we need a clear on-call cadence vs. included hours. Can you split the first 12 months into an implementation retainer + reduced SLA on lower-impact components?
- Credits for migration: given our committed nodes, will Redwood consider implementation credits we can apply to the platform fee?

Attached is a short spreadsheet with our preferred structure (columns for year, platform fee, on-call hours).

Time is tight — would appreciate a proposal by EOD Tuesday PT so we can brief the CFO on Wednesday.

Best,
Jordan Ellis
VP, Engineering
Vermillion Health

Attachments: vermillion-support-asks.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@vermillionhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC deployment — commercial concessions & ops tranching

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet. Appreciate the deadlines; we can move fast. High-level response below and I've attached a short term sheet (Vermillion_TermSheet_v2.pdf) plus an operations tranche worksheet (support-tranches.xlsx).

Proposal (summary):
- Year 1 platform fee: 40% discount to standard on-prem platform fee, applied as a staggered monthly billing (to align with PoC milestones).
- Year 2 onward: step-up to 90% of standard platform fee, with option to cap increases at +5% annually for the initial 3-year agreement.
- Implementation credits: USD 120k credit applied against platform fee over 12 months, conditional on a 36-month committed term and minimum guaranteed node count (as discussed).
- Support: Implementation retainer of 200 hours (flat-fee) covering bootstrapping, rolling upgrades, and runbooks. Post-implementation support tiers: Bronze (business hours, 48h response), Silver (24/7 monitoring + 8h P1 response), Gold (SRE on-call with 2h P1). We map cost to each tranche in the spreadsheet.
- Fallback / rollback: we include a one-time migration playbook and three emergency hours/week of on-call during cutover windows in month 1 at no additional cost.

Open items we need to confirm: node count profile, preferred billing cadence, and whether Vermillion requires SOC 2 evidence shipment to a shared drive (we can attach SOC 2 report once the NDA covers it).

If that looks directionally right I can run this through commercial and legal tomorrow and get a DocuSign term sheet by EOD Thursday.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0198
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachments: Vermillion_TermSheet_v2.pdf, support-tranches.xlsx
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: VPC deployment — concessions (internal)

Sergio — quick internal note before I sign off to Jordan:

I like the structure but recommend tightening the credit conditions and adding a soft cap to the PoC discount to avoid a step-function cliff if node counts exceed projections. Suggested edits (for the term sheet):
- Credit vesting: 50% of the USD 120k credit applies in month 1, remaining 50% vests over the first 6 months based on milestone sign-offs (nodes online, data ingress validated).
- PoC discount cap: discount applies up to 200 nodes; incremental nodes billed at 75% of standard Y1 platform fee.
- SLA carve-outs: add a list of expected third-party downgrade windows (cloud provider maintenance) to protect our SLOs.

Also recommend we offer a single one-time onboarding workshop (remote) and then a discounted hourly rate for additional SRE time after the retainer is exhausted — that helps Vermillion with predictability and reduces our long tail.

If you want, I can produce a short redline to Vermillion_TermSheet_v2.pdf.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@vermillionhealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@vermillionhealth.com>, amanda.cho@vermillionhealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC deployment — commercial concessions & ops tranching

Sergio / Neha,

Thanks — this is helpful and closer to what we need. A few quick clarifications from procurement before we route to legal: 

1) Can you move the credit vesting to a 30/70 split (30% up front, 70% after nodes-online milestone)? Procurement wants more runway before they release the larger portion.
2) The PoC discount cap at 200 nodes is acceptable, but can you add language to allow a quarterly re-evaluation with a rate-card floor so we both avoid surprises?
3) For the support retainer: confirm the hourly rate after the retainer is exhausted and whether those hours are billable in 15-minute increments.

If you can update the term sheet with those three points, we should be able to get this to legal for a quick review. Appreciate the fast turn-around.

Jordan
VP, Engineering
Vermillion Health
